author: Smoebo
source: Painted outside the repository's ComfyUI job list and shipped as 256x256 WebP. The generation tool, prompts and original images were not supplied with the art; scripts/placeholder-set.mjs describes each subject for the silhouette generator and is not the prompt these paintings came from.
subjectBasis: Monster plates are named SRD 5.1 creatures (including every dragon age of the ten SRD colours). Enemy NPC plates are original designs of generic enemy roles painted per race and presentation, per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md.
review: The contributor checked each plate at full size and as a 40px token (contact sheets linked on the pull request).
